AMD beat in each of its last four quarters by about 6% on average, which points to roughly $2.00 actual. The recurring gap between GAAP and adjusted EPS is about $0.53-0.57 (stock comp ~0.30, intangible amortization ~0.33, acquisition costs ~0.02, less tax effects). That gives a base of about $1.43-1.47, consistent with the one GAAP consensus found (Hudson Labs, $1.42). calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: Q2'26 GAAP EPS was 1.38 against 1.66 adjusted, with a $483M investment gain; adjusted consensus is ~1.95; the only GAAP consensus is 1.42; and no warrant shares had vested through Jun 27. I found no factual dispute. The one disagreement is a judgment call on tail width: Run 3 used a 0.40 width while Runs 1 and 2 used ~0.55. Investment marks moved EPS by 0.29 in a single quarter, and the warrant contra-revenue starts on an uncertain date, so I side with the wider width. I put the median at 1.45: the typical beat lifts it slightly above the 1.42 consensus. There was no web access on this run, so I retrieved nothing new.
